_note: Runtime and diagnostic environment declarations. Production deployment uses GitHub Actions; staging database diagnostics and assurance binding reads remain.
_rule: Every difference between two environments is either INTENTIONAL and listed in intentional_differences, or it is drift. There is no third category, and the check treats an unlisted difference as a failure rather than a curiosity.

environments.name: local
environments.purpose: contract, fixture and prototype development on a partner's own Mac

database.note: There is no local Postgres. A session that needs a database uses an ephemeral Neon branch of STAGING, never a local copy of production — a local copy is a production extract on a laptop with no audit and no expiry.

telemetry.destination: out/ logs on that Mac only

environments.name: rehearsal
environments.purpose: migration, restore and reconstruction tests that must not touch a standing environment
environments.data_class: ephemeral; either synthetic or a short-lived restore of an encrypted backup

database.lifetime: created per run, deleted in the same run's teardown
database.note: Branches of STAGING for reconstruction (ops/p1-rebuild-gate.py). bin/restore-rehearse.sh branches PRODUCTION deliberately and by a different route, because proving a backup restores requires production's own data; that script carries its own guards and deletes its branch.

secrets.source: derived per run from the Neon API key; never stored

telemetry.destination: the run's own output and the ops ledger

environments.who_may_write: the script that created the branch, for the life of the branch

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: isolated database diagnostics and assurance scope reads

database.resolution: by name, so a deleted and recreated project is picked up rather than silently missed

environments.name: production
environments.purpose: the system Joe and Dell actually operate on

database.resolution: PINNED BY ID, never by name — resolving production by a name somebody could recreate elsewhere is the worst failure this map could have

secrets.source: wrangler secrets and ~/.config/carr/db.env; never in the repository

telemetry.destination: Cloudflare observability, healthchecks.io dead-man switch, the ops ledger

environments.who_may_write: human-gated paths only; tools/db-tap.py is read-only here without break-glass

intentional_differences.difference: local and rehearsal deploy no Worker at all
intentional_differences.why: Neither is a serving environment. Local is a workstation; rehearsal is a database branch with a lifetime measured in minutes.

intentional_differences.difference: production has KV, R2 and custom domains; database diagnostics deploy no Worker
intentional_differences.why: The GitHub production deploy replaced the local pipeline and its staging Worker declaration. Existing database diagnostics retain their isolated project.
